subject: Setting the TOL limit in mirt function

messages.author: 84aac2580b195c68
messages.subject: Setting the TOL limit in mirt function
parts:
Hello Phil,

While I am calibrating the my data sometimes the solution doesn't converge and process terminates after 500 iterations only. Limit on the number of iterations is coming from the optim{stats}.

What Can I do to let my solution take as many iterations as it needs to converge with by default TOL for EM algorithm (0.0001) without hard coding in the optim() function.



Thanking you,

Irshad

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Setting the TOL limit in mirt function
parts:
Use technical = list(NCYCLES = 1e5), or some other large value to increase the max EM cycles.

Phil
